milestones.title: Architecture specification and integration contracts finalised
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Shared data representations, API contracts, and integration interfaces for all three research pillars and the External Tool and API Orchestration Layer are documented, reviewed, and accepted in writing by all pillar leads (ATU, BIIS, CERIA). Tool registry schema and API adapter interface specifications are finalised and committed to the project repository. Integration test harness is operational and passes a defined smoke-test suite.

milestones.title: Planning engine v1.0 — baseline neuro-symbolic integration
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Planning engine decomposes ≥5 distinct benchmark task types into sub-task graphs with formally specified pre/post-conditions. End-to-end evaluation on ≥1 standardised agent benchmark (e.g., ALFWorld or WebArena) demonstrates measurable plan success rate improvement over an LLM-only baseline, with results recorded in D2-01.

milestones.title: Memory architecture v1.0 — tri-store prototype operational
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Working, episodic, and semantic memory stores are individually operational with a functional memory controller routing reads and writes. Evaluation on synthetic long-horizon tasks (>20 steps) demonstrates measurable coherence improvement over a context-window-only baseline, with results recorded in D3-01.

milestones.title: Multi-agent protocol specification with convergence proofs
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Formal specification of task-delegation and negotiation protocols is complete and peer-reviewed. Convergence proofs are delivered for ≥3 core task classes. Simulation validation with ≥5 heterogeneous agents on synthetic coordination tasks is documented in D4-01.

milestones.title: Demonstrator use cases defined and domain data secured
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Clinical use cases (D5-01), manufacturing scenarios (D6-01), and logistics corridors (D7-01) are fully specified with measurable acceptance criteria. Ethics approval for clinical data access is granted and documented. Factory access agreement is signed. Logistics data access terms are agreed and countersigned.

milestones.title: Integrated MAESTRO framework v1.0 with tool orchestration layer
milestones.verifiable_criterion: All three research pillars and the External Tool and API Orchestration Layer are integrated into a single deployable framework (D3-02, D4-02). Tool registry is populated with ≥10 tools/APIs. End-to-end evaluation on cross-cutting benchmarks demonstrates all three capabilities and tool orchestration operating together. Framework is successfully deployed in at least one demonstrator environment.

milestones.title: Demonstrator v1.0 — initial deployment in all three demonstrator environments
milestones.verifiable_criterion: MAESTRO framework is deployed and functionally operational in the healthcare (NIHS), manufacturing (ISIA), and logistics (ELI) demonstrator environments. Domain-specific tool adapters are operational in each environment. Initial functional evaluation is completed in each sector with results documented. Identified gaps are recorded in a gap analysis report for framework refinement.

milestones.title: Research pillar targets achieved
milestones.verifiable_criterion: OBJ-1 target met: planning engine achieves ≥40% plan success rate improvement over LLM-only baseline on standardised benchmarks (D2-03). OBJ-2 target met: memory architecture achieves ≥30% coherence improvement on long-horizon tasks (D3-03). OBJ-3 target met: coordination protocols achieve ≥25% joint task completion improvement in multi-agent simulations (D4-03). All results are reproducible and documented in respective evaluation reports.

milestones.title: Demonstrator validation complete — all demonstrator environments
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Healthcare demonstrator validated on ≥500 de-identified clinical cases against defined diagnostic benchmarks (D5-03). Manufacturing demonstrator validated over a ≥3-month operational period with KPIs met (D6-03). Logistics transfer demonstrator validated across ≥3 international corridors (D7-03). Tool orchestration layer validated across all demonstrators with ≥30 tools/APIs registered. Cross-demonstrator evaluation report completed and submitted.

milestones.title: Open-source release and platform contributions delivered
milestones.verifiable_criterion: MAESTRO framework is publicly released as open-source on GitHub with a tagged version and OSI-approved licence. Benchmark suite is published on the AI-on-demand platform with a persistent DOI. Developer documentation and ≥2 tutorials are publicly accessible. EDIH dissemination activities are initiated and confirmed in writing by ≥3 EDIH hubs.

milestones.title: Project completion and final review
milestones.verifiable_criterion: All contractual deliverables are submitted to the European Commission portal. Final exploitation plans per partner are delivered and annexed to D9-03. TEF validation reports are completed and submitted. Final project review documentation package is compiled and submitted, including D1-04, D8-04, and D9-03.
